vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Client integration contract
vision.paraphrase: A written client integration document states the tool contract so the skill author can code against it.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Client integration contract
vision.paraphrase: The document records the skill's selection order and that a gateway error never falls back to a personal key.

conops.paraphrase: The skill prefers a connected peak-media server over any personal key.
The skill reports a gateway error to the user and does not fall back to a personal key.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Client integration contract
vision.paraphrase: The document describes the download-into-cache step the skill performs for gateway results.

conops.paraphrase: The client downloads each URL into the local cache under its cache key, skipping files already present, and checks each WAV.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Client integration contract
vision.paraphrase: The document gives the add commands for both servers under the one name peak-media, so the skills see one tool name.

conops.paraphrase: The user adds the gateway with a single claude mcp add command.
The solo user registers the stdio server under the same peak-media name.
